description: React component for the bidder view page in an auction platform, allowing users to view items, place bids, and receive real-time updates on items and bids.

methods.name: BidderView
methods.description: Main React functional component for the bidder interface, managing state, effects, and rendering the auction items and bid form.

methods.name: loadHighBid
methods.description: Fetches the highest bid for a specific item and updates the highBids state.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Fetches the list of items for an event and initiates high bid loading for each item.

methods.name: handleBid
methods.description: Creates a function to handle placing a bid on a specific item, including error handling.
